findings.title: Shoppers can be shown unlisted gear and missing selected pieces as a successful try-on — provider images are returned without checking the rendered contents
findings.observed: Any nonempty provider image returns success, even if it omits a selected item or adds gear.

findings.title: The operator can incur uncontrolled model charges from anonymous traffic — both paid AI routes lack any rate, quota or abuse guard
findings.observed: Both paid AI routes still lack an app-level quota; external gateway limits could not be read.

findings.title: Shoppers see removed or swapped gear still worn on their model — outfit changes neither regenerate nor invalidate the existing or pending preview
findings.observed: Swapping or removing gear leaves the old preview; a pending old request can replace it too.

findings.title: Shoppers can see clothing with no corresponding selected listing — the try-on prompt explicitly preserves selfie clothes or adds a black base layer
findings.observed: Empty outfits keep selfie clothing; selected outfits prescribe an unlisted black base layer.

findings.title: The measurement requirement can be bypassed by API clients — try-on accepts a missing body profile and generates without one
findings.observed: POST /tryon accepts profile=null and can generate a model without height, weight or fit.

findings.title: Marketplace integrators cannot reliably request all gear or its fit status — product endpoints ignore fits_only and never return a fit boolean
findings.observed: fits_only=false with height_cm still filters; product and detail responses have no fit boolean.

findings.title: Shoppers can receive highlighted gear outside their measurements — assistant fit validation removes equip IDs but not highlights
findings.observed: A non-fitting id in highlight is returned unchanged and can be shown as a recommendation.

findings.title: Shoppers can select sold-out gear and then lose their try-on — the catalog and equip controls do not enforce in_stock
findings.observed: A sold-out product can be equipped; the subsequent try-on rejects it with HTTP 409.

findings.title: Shoppers can save the wrong weight and see incorrect fit results — switching kg and lb changes the interpretation without converting the entered value
findings.observed: Switching 70 kg to lb leaves 70 in the field and saves 32 kg.

findings.title: Shoppers editing their measurements can be forced to re-enter or accidentally restore an old height — reopening initializes centimetres but not feet and inches
findings.observed: After changing a previously entered 5'11" to 160 cm, ft/in still shows the old 5'11".

findings.title: Shoppers choosing all fits still miss women's gear — saving the other fit never clears the previous gender filter
findings.observed: Changing Men's fit to Show all fits leaves the catalog gender filter set to men.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot compare item lengths from the catalog and one listing has no length anywhere — cards omit length and the circlet seed leaves it empty
findings.observed: No catalog card shows length; Moonstone Elven Circlet also has length_cm=null in its detail.

findings.title: Shoppers see results for an old filter after choosing a new one — completed product requests are not checked against the latest filter
findings.observed: A slower old fit or gender request can overwrite the newer filtered catalog.

findings.title: Shoppers lose existing filters on a follow-up stylist request — assistant filters replace all controls rather than merging the returned changes
findings.observed: A max-price-only response clears the saved gender, category, color and search filters.

findings.title: Shoppers lose the saved look they selected while a preview is generating — selecting history does not invalidate the pending generation
findings.observed: A pending image can overwrite the selected history preview and leave the worn list mismatched.

findings.title: Marketplace shoppers lose sight of equipped items in new categories — the wardrobe and checkout enumerate only eight hardcoded slots
findings.observed: An equipped item in a new category is absent from the outfit list, count and checkout.

findings.title: Stylist recommendations can violate the shopper's color or budget — response cleanup checks only whether IDs exist, not whether they match the request
findings.observed: A valid fitting but wrong-color or over-budget catalog ID is returned and equipped unchanged.

findings.title: Shoppers see a false stylist success when the model supplies no answer — missing reply text is replaced with 'Done.' instead of an error
findings.observed: Missing or empty model reply is returned as the successful assistant message 'Done.'.

findings.title: Shoppers who queue the same voice or text command twice get duplicated chat entries and polluted conversation history — processing one queued text clears every matching queued marker
findings.observed: Two identical queued commands are both unmarked on the first pass; the second is appended again.

findings.title: Shoppers can have newer commands run ahead of queued changes — the queue releases its busy lock before scheduling its next message
findings.observed: A new send between busy=false and the queued timer starts before the older queued command.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot identify their size for individual listings — the drawer uses a generic body size even when the item lacks it, and cards show only size ranges
findings.observed: At 170 cm/70 kg, the L-only Silver Sallet fits but no size is highlighted; cards show no suggestion.

findings.title: Shoppers can see a model with their old proportions marked current after editing measurements — profile edits do not invalidate in-flight generation or enter the render key
findings.observed: An old-profile image can finish after editing and reset the dirty key to the current outfit.

findings.title: Shoppers lose a stylist turn when the model returns malformed action IDs — response cleanup iterates unvalidated values outside the error handler
findings.observed: If equip contains a JSON object, checking membership in ids raises TypeError after the try block.

findings.title: Shoppers can receive nonexistent or sold-out recommendations — only action IDs are checked while the assistant's free-text reply is displayed unchanged
findings.observed: A model reply naming an invented or sold-out item is displayed without validating that name.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot find a suggested listing in the catalog grid — recommendations do not clear or reconcile filters that hide highlighted items
findings.observed: A highlighted black helmet remains absent from the grid if an existing white filter is kept.

findings.title: Landscape phone shoppers can lose measurement fields or the save control — the centered modal is taller than a short viewport and cannot scroll
findings.observed: The centered measurements dialog has no viewport-height limit or scrolling on short screens.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot readily identify the outfit piece blocking a preview — the 409 error exposes catalog IDs instead of marking and naming selected items
findings.observed: An unavailable worn listing is reported only as its raw ID and its outfit row is not marked.

findings.title: Queued follow-up commands reach the stylist in the wrong conversation order — queued user bubbles are inserted before earlier replies and reused as history
findings.observed: With A pending and B queued, history is sent as user A, user B, assistant A, assistant B.

findings.title: Shoppers can lose the head or footwear from a generated full-body look — the fixed 4:5 mirror uses object-cover for images of other aspect ratios
findings.observed: A full-body 2:3 preview is vertically cropped inside the 4:5 mirror by object-cover.

findings.title: Shoppers can lose an entire carefully assembled selection with one click — Clear all deletes worn and set-aside items without confirmation or undo
findings.observed: Clear all immediately discards worn and set-aside selections without confirmation or undo.

findings.title: Shoppers turning off the fit filter still cannot see all catalog gear — the automatically applied gender filter remains active
findings.observed: After selecting men's fit, disabling fits-only still hides women's listings.

findings.title: Shoppers can receive unfitting gear after updating their measurements — in-flight stylist results are applied without checking the current profile
findings.observed: A response generated for an old profile is applied after measurements have been changed.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot tell why a long stylist request is rejected — the input has no length limit and validation errors are reported as an unavailable assistant
findings.observed: A 1001-character message gets HTTP 422 and displays 'The Quartermaster is away. Try again.'

findings.title: Shoppers can lose catalog filtering after a malformed stylist reply — filter values are accepted as arbitrary strings rather than checked against each field's type
findings.observed: A model filter max_price='cheap' passes cleanup and the next products request gets 422.

findings.title: Invalid selfie payloads can reach paid generation — try-on decodes any image bytes without checking the data-URL format or size
findings.observed: Raw base64 images and arbitrarily large selfie payloads still pass the server image check.

findings.title: A visitor's very large selfie can stall other shoppers' requests — unrestricted image decoding and resizing block the server event loop
findings.observed: Unbounded selfie decoding and resizing still run synchronously on the async server event loop.

findings.title: Shoppers with a full outfit can time out before image generation starts — product images are fetched serially with a separate 20-second timeout each
findings.observed: Eight uncached images can each wait 20s, exceeding the browser's 150s try-on timeout.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot find later catalog items once the marketplace grows past 1000 products — all catalog and stylist reads are capped without pagination
findings.observed: Catalog and stylist reads still stop at 1000 products without pagination.

findings.title: Catalog and stylist requests slow as marketplace products accumulate — price-sorted and attribute-filter reads lack matching indexes
findings.observed: Needs products(price ASC) and (gender/color/aesthetic, price ASC) indexes.

findings.title: Shoppers get an unhandled server error when a gear image fails or the model key is missing — setup occurs outside the provider error handlers
findings.observed: Product image fetch and missing AI key failures still occur outside provider error handlers.

findings.title: Timed-out AI requests can continue consuming server resources and provider credits after shoppers retry — model calls have no backend deadline
findings.observed: Client timeouts still leave paid model calls running without a backend deadline.

findings.title: Shoppers can see a broken preview instead of an error — generated image data is neither decoded and validated nor given a load-error fallback
findings.observed: A nonempty invalid image is returned successfully and the preview has no image-load fallback.

findings.title: Duplicate try-on requests can charge the operator twice — the anonymous generation endpoint has no idempotency or in-flight deduplication
findings.observed: Repeated identical try-on POSTs still start separate paid model requests.

findings.title: A shopper's newer wardrobe choice can be set aside when an older stylist reply arrives — late equip operations overwrite the current category
findings.observed: An older chat response can still replace a newer manual choice in the same category.

findings.title: Fit-filtered catalog requests slow as marketplace listings grow — the new height and weight range query has no sizing index and scans products
findings.observed: No products(sizing.min_height_cm ASC, price ASC) index serves the default fit query.

findings_minor.title: The demo cannot exercise sold-out marketplace listings — every sample item is seeded in stock
findings_minor.observed: Every seeded listing sets in_stock=true; no sample listing is unavailable.

findings_minor.title: Voice users receive no explanation when microphone access or recognition fails — the speech error handler only resets state
findings_minor.observed: Microphone denial silently turns listening off; other recognition failures restart silently.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers do not see which measurement fields are required or errors beside them — the dialog has only a single form-level message
findings_minor.observed: Height, weight and fit are not marked required; one shared error is shown below all fields.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers cannot review their measurements in their chosen units — the profile discards unit preferences and the tag always uses metric
findings_minor.observed: A profile entered in feet/inches and pounds is always shown as centimetres and kilograms.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers can accidentally discard a new selfie before entering measurements — the required dialog can be dismissed instead of keeping the user in the form
findings_minor.observed: Cancel or Escape closes the required dialog and discards the newly uploaded selfie.

findings_minor.title: A pasted long URL can overflow the stylist chat on a phone — message bubbles do not break long words
findings_minor.observed: A long unbroken chat message still has no word-breaking style and can overflow its bubble.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers cannot see the requested One of a kind badge on catalog cards — the card uses a different One-off label
findings_minor.observed: One-of-a-kind catalog cards say 'One-off', not the required 'One of a kind' badge.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers using Remove in the Equipped tray still find the item in their selection — the control calls the take-off toggle instead of remove
findings_minor.observed: The Equipped tray's Remove control moves the item to set aside instead of deleting it.

findings_minor.title: Marketplace integrators cannot submit measurements in imperial units — the backend profile accepts only pre-converted centimetres and kilograms
findings_minor.observed: Profiles expressed as feet/inches and pounds lack height_cm and weight_kg and receive 422.
